name: Canvas
description: Canvas is an entity which you can draw onto it.

parameters.name: is_visible
parameters.description: Whether to draw it on screen

parameters.name: clear_color
parameters.description: Color to clear with (background color)

parameters.name: auto_repaint_rate
parameters.description: Rate to auto repaint (call Update event), pass 0 for every frame, -1 to disable

parameters.name: should_clear_before_update
parameters.description: Whether to clear with Clear Color before updates

parameters.name: auto_resize
parameters.description: Auto resize with screen's size

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: If not using auto_resize

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: If not using auto_resize

parameters.name: screen_position
parameters.description: If not using auto_resize, offset when drawing to screen

functions.name: DrawMaterial
functions.description: Draws a Material on the Canvas
functions.description_long:
Draws a Material on the Canvas

This method can only be called from inside Update event

Note: Due how Unreal handles Render Targets, drawing material on Canvas result on a weird translucent effect. Hope in the future to be improved.

parameters.name: material_path
parameters.description: The Material asset to use

parameters.name: screen_position
parameters.description: Position on the Canvas, in pixels

parameters.name: screen_size
parameters.description: Size on the Canvas, in pixels

parameters.name: coordinate_position
parameters.description: Top-left UV coordinate of the source to draw (0 to 1)

parameters.name: coordinate_size
parameters.description: UV size of the source to draw (0 to 1), use (1, 1) for the whole source

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.description: Rotation in degrees

parameters.name: pivot_point
parameters.description: Pivot of the rotation, relative to the drawing size (0.5, 0.5 is the center)

parameters.name: blend_mode
parameters.description: How it blends with what is already drawn

functions.name: DrawText
functions.description: Draws a Text on the Canvas
functions.description_long:
Draws a Text on the Canvas

This method can only be called from inside Update event

Shadow and Outline won't work properly with Transparent clear_color

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to draw

parameters.name: screen_position
parameters.description: Position on the Canvas, in pixels

parameters.name: font_type
parameters.description: Font to use

parameters.name: font_size
parameters.description: Font size

parameters.name: text_color
parameters.description: Color of the text

parameters.name: kerning
parameters.description: Extra spacing between characters

parameters.name: center_x
parameters.description: Whether to center the text horizontally on the position

parameters.name: center_y
parameters.description: Whether to center the text vertically on the position

parameters.name: shadow_color
parameters.description: Color of the text shadow, transparent to disable it

parameters.name: shadow_offset
parameters.description: Offset of the shadow, in pixels

parameters.name: outlined
parameters.description: Whether to draw an outline around the text

parameters.name: outline_color
parameters.description: Color of the outline

You can only call :Draw...() methods from inside this event
